title: What Is Free Verse? — A Literary Guide for English Students and Teachers
skills: identify characteristics of free verse poetry
analyze how line breaks and rhythm function without a fixed meter or rhyme scheme
explain how structural freedom contributes to tone, voice, and meaning
alignment_note: Introduces free verse as poetry that does not follow a fixed meter or rhyme scheme while still using deliberate rhythm, lineation, imagery, and sound. Supports analysis of poetic form, structure, voice, and author's craft across high school English courses.
